335:Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger: self-issue an ID-JAG, redeem it at the target authorization server (RFC 7523), and
call the MCP server with the resulting access token. See the [XAA Debugger guide](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md) for the tru
st setup, registration strategies, and CI usage.
569:An unknown ID, or an ID or flag for a suite the run leaves out, is a usage error (exit code `2`) before anything runs.
597:| `--server <name=url>` | | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL. Repeatable. Split on the first `=`; duplicate or unknown n
ames are usage errors. |
611:Global `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usa
ge/unsupported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or interrupted; see [Exit codes](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).
643:`--host` is a usage error rather than a silent precedence rule.
954:Launch a goal run. **Spends model credits**: fans out into `targets × iterations` chat sessions.
961:| `--expected-sponsored <n>` | No | How many of this launch's conversations you expect to be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's per
-user allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the launch is refused with a `409` and nothi
ng is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
1209:Grade a saved server against a publisher's directory as the platform reaches it, through the saved server row and the authori
ze exchange. This is the hosted half of `readiness check`: it answers a different question (what the platform sees, not what your
machine sees), can optionally run a model for experience observations (included with MCPJam; no credits are consumed), and leaves
a persistent record.
1229:| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |

or `enterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage error. |

ll). Zero credits spent if it happened before launch |
